scope: Shared local Italian speech-to-text used by P05 and reusable by later pages

privacyContract.audioLifetime: MediaRecorder chunks and the assembled Blob remain transient in memory and references are released after completion, cancellation or error.

physicalProcedure: Open an active course, then Allievi, the page menu and Conoscenza; open one student's note with the pencil control.
Type a short prefix into the note before starting dictation.
Tap Dettatura and confirm that microphone permission is requested only now.
On a cold first use, confirm that a real asset-loading state and measured progress appear before recording begins.
Speak one short Italian sentence, tap Termina and confirm that processing is followed by an editable transcript appended after the typed prefix.
Edit the result, tap Usa testo, close the panel, reload the app and confirm that the final text persists.
Repeat dictation and tap Scarta; confirm that the text that existed immediately before the new transcript is restored.
Deny permission once, then retry; cancel once during an active phase. Confirm that the typed text survives, retry remains available and the operating-system microphone indicator turns off.

Record the cold-load, warm-load and recording-to-review times, the expected phrase, the observed transcript, any recognition errors, and the browser and operating-system versions. There is no fixed latency or accuracy threshold, but the result must be reviewable and recoverable.

closureRule: By explicit human instruction on 2026-09-08, these physical checks are deferred to the final UG1 release gate so implementation can continue. UG1 cannot close until all three targets contain real observations and the user-facing flow is reviewable and recoverable on each target. Mock or injected transcription evidence cannot replace these results.
